fnol_text: My name is Ethan Castillo and I live at 791 Thornbury Court, Riverton, WY 82573. You can reach me on (555) 833-1015 or ethan.castillo@example.com. On 28 October 2026 I tried to drive through a flooded road under the bridge. The water was deeper than I thought and the engine cut out and filled with water. Policy MT-2025-00129. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Castillo on (555) 833-1015 to acknowledge the claim. Ethan confirmed the loss date as 28 October 2026.
